recipes.name: The Most Easy and Delish Meatloaf EVER!
ingredients_raw: 1 (14 ounce) can diced tomatoes with green chile peppers (such as RO*TEL®), undrained
1 sleeve buttery round crackers (such as Ritz®), crushed
1.5 teaspoons garlic powder, or to taste
1.5 teaspoons seasoned salt, or to taste
0.5 teaspoon ground black pepper, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

Beat the egg in a mixing bowl, then add the ground beef, tomatoes, and crushed crackers. Season with onion flakes, garlic powder, seasoned salt, and pepper. Mix until evenly combined. Pack into a 9x5 inch loaf pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center, about 1 hour. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: The Most Easy and Delish Meatloaf EVER!
raw_recipe.description: This quick meatloaf requires no chopping whatsoever.

review.reviewBody: My husband loved this recipe. I added a little of A-1 sauce to the meat and omitted the tomatoes-mix. I also used catsup,mustard, and BBQ sauce on the top for the entire cooking time. He said it was the best he has ever had! Cooking time was perfect - moist...the best.

I don’t usually think it’s fair to give a recipe a rating if I didn’t follow the recipe. However, I made a few tweaks to it based on reviews other members gave and I’ll base my rating on that. First of all, we all LOVED it. It will definitely be in our regular rotation. I doubled the recipe and here is what I put in it: 3 lb hamburger 4 eggs 2 (14 ounce) cans diced tomatoes with green chile peppers (such as RO*TEL®), undrained 1 sleeve buttery crackers, crushed (I used Club Crackers) 1 medium onion, chopped 1/2 tsp onion powder 1 T garlic powder 1 T seasoned salt 1 tsp ground black pepper 1 T Worcestershire sauce 1 T steak sauce Ketchup with a little brown sugar stirred in to put on top I mixed together everything except the hamburger, ketchup and brown sugar. Then put the hamburger in and mixed it until incorporated. I put it in a 9x13 pan and put the ketchup/brown sugar mixture on top. I baked it at 375 for 1 hr 15 min. Then I turned the oven off and let it sit in it until I finished preparing the mashed potatoes and corn.
Loved it, but felt it had too much filler. I’ll decrease the buttery crackers by only using a half sleeve and use 1/2 a can of Rotel, drained. 2 eggs instead of one.

I've made many elaborate meatloaves that take 30 minutes or more to put together, and this one is equally as tasty and just takes a few minutes to toss all the ingredients together. The tomato/green chili really makes this tasty!

I did drain the tomato/green chili, and subbed 1/2 cup of plain dried breadcrumbs for the crackers. Added 1 Tbsp Worcestshire sauce. It did turn out a bit salty so next time will use half the seasoned salt.

Topped with our favorite glaze the last 10 minutes of cooking - 1/2 cup ketchup, 2 Tbsp light brown sugar, 1 tsp powdered dried mustard (also good with a couple tsp lemon juice).

Used onion power for onion flakes. Otherwise stuck to recipe. Did add a topping at the start which I mixed 1 tablespoon each-ketchup, mustard and Open Pit BBQ sauce. in a cup and layer the top of meatloaf. Added sharp cheddar in the last 10 minutes of baking. This was so simple a 79 year old guy can even make it and it was super!

AMAZING! This recipe is not only easy as can be but my picky eaters loved it and so did hubby! I followed the recipe exactly except I used FLAVORED crackers; rosemary and sage (that's all I had on hand) and it was INCREDIBLE! My kids loved crushing the crackers up! I also used egg beaters and I couldn't tell a difference. I couldn't find my large baking tin so I used 2 cupcake tins. The "individual servings" came out PERFECT. Freeze the leftovers!! The kids made meatball subs with ease out of 1 serving! I made cheddar mashed potatoes to go with! All I can say is, DOUBLE THE RECIPE because it will be gone! And be sure to use the RO TEL tomatoes!!

I wrote this recipe many years ago. Whoever the editing person is has changed the recipe some. It was supposed to be 1 tsp of salt. 2 tsp to a TBSP of garlic (depending on your liking) plus a tsp of onion powder. Onion flakes optional. Oh and yes 2eggs. I always baked mine in a square pan or a cake type pan so idk why they put to use a loaf pan on the directions. Rotel only comes in a 10 oz can. 14 oz would be too much liquid. Hopefully they’ll see this and fix it???
I did tweak this recipe a bit. I added 1 can of hot Rotel and 1 can of fire roasted Rotel, half of an onion and Sweet baby Rays barbecue sauce as a glaze. My fiancé loved it.

Made this meatloaf for supper tonight and all I can say is that it's DELICIOUS! I had a 10 ounce can of Rotel ( does Rotel even make a 14 ounce can?) which I put in. Instead of the Ritz crackers I had to substitute 1/2 cup of matzo meal due to the holiday of Passover and it was still delicious. I could only imagine what the meatloaf tastes like with the Ritz crackers, and I will try it again with the Ritz after Passover finishes. Thank you for posting this winning recipe! Made it again using 1/2 cup bread crumbs and placed in 12 muffin cups. Baked at 350 for 45 minutes....FAB!!
Made it Nov.28/16 and realized I had no canned tomatoes so subbed salsa instead and it was equally delish!

Both my picky kid and my hubby love this. I’ve made it both with beef AND ground turkey and it still was delicious. I do replace the crumbled crackers with plain panko breadcrumbs though and also top it with sauce (made of about a 1/3 or more cups of ketchup mixed with a few tablespoons of mustard and about 2 tbsp brown sugar all mixed well and poured on top prior to putting it in the oven). This has become my family’s favorite dinner ??

This will be my new go to meatloaf recipe. Super easy to make & my family loved it. I followed the advice in other reviews & added an extra egg. Also, I needed to do it gluten free so omitted the crackers & used 1/2 cup cooked quinoa.
Made exactly as recipe calls for and it was delish!
Perfect! Wanted Rotel, got Rotel. Anyone notice how cost had gone up? All’s fair in food and Tariff’s?

Just added a little diced bell pepper and onion and used garlic salt in place of the garlic powder and season salt. Put a little ketchup on top of the loaf for the last 10 minutes of baking. Was delicious! Will definitely make this again!

It's those "buttery" ", ritzy" crackers and the diced tomatoes, onions and peppers but I just can't eat meatloaf, because to me, it's not even meatloaf without adding my diced up green bell peppers but that's the only thing I added or changed! Great meatloaf! Wonderful meatloaf Sammy tlhe next day as well. All 3 meals! LOL!

This is PERFECT the way that it is! I have never liked meatloaf and I absolutely love it. My husband is lucky enough to get to eat all over the world and he loves it as well! Easy, and delicious..... YES please!
This is so good! Exactly as written, my family loves it! The name describes it perfectly.
Very good!

I made this last night and it was the easiest meatloaf recipe I've made. I'll be using this recipe from now on. I doubled the recipe and cooked it in a foil lined 9x13 pan. The only changes I made were a adding a few splashes of worcestershire to the mixture and using fire roasted ro-tel because that's what I had on hand. The fire-roasted was a good choice because it has a little more flavor without adding heat.. I had the meatloaf in the oven in less than 10 minutes.
I liked it and I don't like meatloaf. The last 10 minutes, I added taco sauce and cheese to the top.
